# Interaction comparision {.tabset .tabset-fade}

We are doing comparison between:

- MCC vs. MEL (after updating mislabeled cancer cells)
- MCC vs. MEL (after deletion of mislabeled cancer cells)

- R vs. NR
- R vs. NR (after updating mislabeled cancer cells)
- R vs. NR (after deletion of mislabeled cancer cells)

- MCC R vs. MCC NR (after updating mislabeled cancer cells)
- MCC R vs. MCC NR (after deletion of mislabeled cancer cells)

- MCC YUEYE & MCC YUMISTY
```{r message=FALSE}
# create a function that run cellchat for MDK
# Inputs:
# cc1_name: cellchat object 1 name, cc1: cellchat object 1
# cc2_name: cellchat object 2 name, cc2: cellchat object 2
run_cellchat_MDK <- function(object.list){
  # create the merged cellchat object
  cellchat <- mergeCellChat(object.list, add.names = names(object.list))
  
  # bar plots
  gg1 <- compareInteractions(cellchat, show.legend = F, group = c(1,2))
  gg2 <- compareInteractions(cellchat, show.legend = F, group = c(1,2), measure = "weight")
  print(gg1 + gg2)
  
  # differential circle plots
  par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
  netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat, weight.scale = T)
  netVisual_diffInteraction(cellchat, weight.scale = T, measure = "weight")
  
  # num of interaction circle plots for the two object side by side
  weight.max <- getMaxWeight(object.list, attribute = c("idents","count"))
  par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
  for (i in 1:length(object.list)) {
    netVisual_circle(object.list[[i]]@net$count, weight.scale = T, label.edge= T, edge.weight.max = weight.max[2], edge.width.max = 12, title.name = paste0("Number of interactions - ", names(object.list)[i]))
  }
  
  # weight of interaction circle plots for the two object side by side
  weight.max <- getMaxWeight(object.list, attribute = c("idents","weight"))
  par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
  for (i in 1:length(object.list)) {
    netVisual_circle(object.list[[i]]@net$weight, weight.scale = T, label.edge= T, edge.weight.max = weight.max[2], edge.width.max = 12, arrow.size = 0.5, title.name = paste0("Weight of interactions - ", names(object.list)[i]))
  }
  
  # bubble plots
  if (names(object.list)[2] != "MEL"){
    netVisual_bubble(cellchat, sources.use = c("MCC"), comparison = c(1, 2), angle.x = 45, thresh = 1)
  } else {
    netVisual_bubble(object.list[[1]], sources.use = c("MCC"), angle.x = 45, thresh = 1)
  }
}
```


## MCC vs. MEL after updating
* bubble plot is created only from interactions in MCC since no interactions are in MEL
```{r}
object.list <- list(MCC = cellchat_MCC_updated, MEL = cellchat_MEL_updated)
run_cellchat_MDK(object.list)
```

## MCC vs. MEL after deletion
* bubble plot is created only from interactions in MCC since no interactions are in MEL
```{r}
object.list <- list(MCC = cellchat_MCC_deleted, MEL = cellchat_MEL_deleted)
run_cellchat_MDK(object.list)
```

## R vs. NR
```{r}
object.list <- list(R = cellchat_R, NR = cellchat_NR)
run_cellchat_MDK(object.list)
```

## R vs. NR after updating
```{r}
object.list <- list(R = cellchat_R_updated, NR = cellchat_NR_updated)
run_cellchat_MDK(object.list)
```

## R vs. NR after deletion
```{r}

```

```{r}

```

## MCC YUEYE vs MCC YUMISTY (after updating)
